title: Small pointwise right Kan extension and its precomposition adjunction
statement:
Fix a universe $\mathcal V$ [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $C,D$ be $\mathcal V$-small categories [def-nagata-category], $L:C\to D$ a functor and $\mathcal A$ a locally $\mathcal V$-small category with all $\mathcal V$-small limits. A limit of a diagram $M:I\to\mathcal A$ is a cone $(x,(p_i:x\to M(i)))$ through which every other cone factors uniquely. For $d\in D$, let $(d\downarrow L)$ have objects $(c,b:d\to Lc)$ and arrows $(c,b)\to(c',b')$ the arrows $g:c\to c'$ with $L(g)b=b'$. With $\pi_d(c,b)=c$, the pointwise right Kan extension $T$ is a functor in $F:C\to\mathcal A$, with natural identifications
$$ (TF)(d)\cong\lim_{(d\downarrow L)}F\pi_d. $$
Precomposition $P(G)=G L$ is left adjoint to $T$: there are natural bijections $\operatorname{Nat}(PG,F)\cong\operatorname{Nat}(G,TF)$. The counit $\epsilon_F:PTF\to F$ at $c$ is the limit projection indexed by $(c,1_{Lc})$. The unit $\eta_G:G\to TPG$ is the unique map whose projection at $(c,b)$ is $G(b):G(d)\to G(Lc)$; unit and counit satisfy the triangle identities. Here functors preserve identities and compositions, natural transformations commute with every arrow, and $\operatorname{Nat}$ denotes their set.
